name: Sector ETF Performance During High Inflation (CPI YoY > 4%)
description: Identifies periods where YoY CPI inflation exceeds 4% and measures sector ETF performance (XLE, XLK, XLF, XLP) during those episodes. Computes full-period returns per episode, ranks sectors by average return, shows cumulative returns with inflation bands, and marks episode entry dates.
source:
# ============================================================
# Sector ETF Performance During High Inflation (CPI YoY > 4%)
# Threshold: 4% YoY CPI. Episodes defined by crossover/crossunder.
# Assets: XLE, XLK, XLF, XLP (study_assets)
# ============================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()()
ts = index().value

# CPI: monthly, forward-filled to daily
cpi_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="CPIAUCSL")
cpi = ffill(cpi_raw.result)

# --- Inflation Regime ---
# YoY CPI = (CPI / CPI_12m_ago) - 1
cpi_lag12 = cpi >> 252  # ~12 months in trading days
cpi_yoy = (cpi / cpi_lag12) - 1

# Threshold
threshold = 0.04

# Episode entry/exit
episode_entry = crossover(cpi_yoy, threshold)
episode_exit = crossunder(cpi_yoy, threshold)
in_episode = hold_until(episode_entry, episode_exit)

# --- Performance: Episode Returns ---
# Capture close at episode entry
entry_price = valuewhen(episode_entry, src.c, occurrence=0)

# Episode return at exit = (close_at_exit / entry_price) - 1
episode_return_at_exit = where(episode_exit, (src.c / entry_price) - 1)

# --- Cumulative Returns (full history) ---
# Cumulative return from first bar using agg to get first valid close
first_close = agg(src.c, AggregationType.First)
cum_ret = (src.c / first_close) - 1

# --- CHART 1: Rank Sectors by Avg Episode Return ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title="Which Sectors Win During High Inflation?",
    x_axis_label="Sector ETF",
    y_axis_label="Avg Full-Period Return",
    category="Inflation Regime Analysis",
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(episode_return_at_exit)

# --- CHART 2: Cumulative Returns with Inflation Bands ---
# inflation band flag: 1 when in episode, 0 otherwise
inflation_band = where(in_episode, 1.0, 0.0)

xy_lines(
    title="Cumulative Returns vs Inflation Episodes",
    y_axis_label="Cumulative Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label="Date",
    category="Inflation Regime Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Cumulative Return", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="CPI YoY > 4%", color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(ts, cum_ret, inflation_band)

# --- EVENTS: Mark Episode Entry Dates ---
# CPI YoY level as percent for display
cpi_yoy_pct = cpi_yoy * 100

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Inflation > 4%",
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="CPI YoY", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="ETF Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(cpi_yoy, src.c, episode_entry)

# --- TABLE: Summary by Sector ETF ---
# Avg episode duration: use datetime_diff between entry and exit timestamps
entry_ts = valuewhen(episode_entry, ts, occurrence=0)
exit_ts = valuewhen(episode_exit, ts, occurrence=0)
episode_duration = where(episode_exit, datetime_diff(unit=TimeDiffUnit.days)(entry_ts, exit_ts).value)

cs_summary_table(
    title="Sector Performance During High Inflation Episodes",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category="Inflation Regime Analysis",
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Sector Performance During High Inflation Episodes",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return (%)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Best Episode (%)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Worst Episode (%)", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="# Episodes", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Duration (days)", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(agg(episode_return_at_exit, AggregationType.Mean), agg(episode_return_at_exit, AggregationType.Max), agg(episode_return_at_exit, AggregationType.Min), agg(episode_return_at_exit, AggregationType.Count), agg(episode_duration, AggregationType.Mean))
